```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(knitr)
library(tidyverse)
library(here)

# Load data safely
tryCatch({
  source("jpbsCVdata/load_cv_data.r")
  cv_data <- load_cv_data()
  if (!is.null(cv_data)) {
    list2env(cv_data, envir = .GlobalEnv)
  }
}, error = function(e) {
  message("Using fallback data")
})

# Ensure we don't output tibbles
options(knitr.kable.NA = '')
```
